call_chain_read_page.description: Complete call chain for reading a database page, traced from API to disk I/O

chain.action: thin wrapper: pass cmd=288 + args to dispatcher
logging, error state check, call core impl
read header page + target page via sub_5AF0640; manage page cache (realloc)
call FHDBRN; on error 11: wait + retry; on persistent fail: mode switch CLOSED→READ→retry; abort on final fail
dereference Fortran pointer args, call sub_5B9B400(token, pageno, buf, handle*4, 1)
lookup IToken via MR_Message, RTDynamicCast to DirectAccessToken, vtable call at offset 16
actual disk page read via OS file I/O

MR_Message.description: Message/messaging infrastructure. Used for token lookup in I/O dispatch.

IToken.description: Abstract token interface for file I/O access.

DirectAccessToken.description: Concrete token implementing direct file access (page read/write).
DirectAccessToken.evidence: RTTI at 0x6150A38, target of RTDynamicCast from IToken
